messages:
tess-marketing: quick note 1: noticed a rise in inbound leads landing in the unclaimed bucket during APAC morning. small numbers (2.5% today) but consistent. could be enrichment latency.

devin-salesops: can you share an example lead id or the worker log?

tess-marketing: pasted a worker trace snippet below: 
```
2026-03-22T01:47:11Z WARN enrichment_worker request timed out after 3500ms lead_id=cb12a4
2026-03-22T01:47:11Z INFO fallback route -> mark contact enrichment_status=failed and route to fallback_queue
```

ana-growth: (typo 1: should be ana-growth) fyi last week's enrichment optimization lowered the timeout to 3.5s to improve latency, but HS often takes 4-6s in APAC mornings.

sam-engineering: plan proposal: implement a "fast-fallback" path: if enrich timeout -> attach minimal enrichment (email + company domain) and continue round-robin instead of immediate unassigned. run as 12% canary for 3h.

devin-salesops: alternative is bumping global TTL to 8s, but that raises outbound latency for everyone. canary sounds safer.

leo-sdr: request: when fallback occurs, add contact property "enrich_source=fallback_minimal" and include enrich_error_reason (timeout|no_data). helps prioritization.

sam-engineering: agreed. will emit metrics: inbound.enrich.fallback.count, inbound.enrich.reason.timeout.count, inbound.claim.latency.p95.

tess-marketing: also can we have a dashboard tile showing "unassigned leads by hour" so marketing can correlate spikes to campaign sends?

devin-salesops: yes, i'll add a widget in Looker and a datadog alert if unassigned_rate > 1.5% for a 30m window.

sam-engineering: rollout steps: 1) implement minimal-fallback code path behind feature-flag 2) deploy canary to 12% at 03:00 UTC 3) monitor 3h, if fallback_rate < 1% and claim_latency p95 unchanged -> promote. otherwise rollback.

ana-growth: can we also update HubSpot workflow so fallback leads get assigned to a temporary "fallback-queue" owner and get an SDR notification? devin?

devin-salesops: will set up HS workflow: if enrichment_status=failure and feature_flag=canary -> set owner=fallback-queue and add property enrich_source=fallback_minimal. scheduling the workflow for canary start. hubspot-bot: please schedule at 03:00 UTC.

hubspot-bot: scheduled workflow change: enrichment-fallback -> set owner=fallback-queue at 2026-03-23T03:00:00Z. initiated by devin-salesops.

leo-sdr: one more ask: add a saved view in HubSpot for "Fallback leads" so SDRs can triage quickly.

devin-salesops: will create saved view + temporary playbook doc in Confluence. tagging leo for UX review.

sam-engineering: deployed canary to 12% at 2026-03-23T03:01:12Z. metrics live.

tess-marketing: thanks 1: please keep comms light to SDRs 1: we don't want panic. a short note in #sales with the playbook link should be enough.

devin-salesops: will post the playbook and set a 3h check-in reminder.

analytics-check: if fallback reduces unassigned rate by >40% we should consider a targeted TTL increase only during APAC mornings as a follow-up.

sam-engineering: noted. logging metrics to datadog: tag=region:apac, feature:fallback_minimal.

leo-sdr: first fallback lead just appeared in the view, enrich_reason=timeout. tagging looks correct. thanks team. :thumbsup:
